name: EFA-NG / MailWatch-NG
title: EFA-NG 6.0.5 Released
short_description: Official Telegram support channel (t.me/EFA_NG), modernized eFa-Configure multi-mode console, mathematical terminal border alignment, and system update improvements.
upgrade_command: dnf clean all && dnf -y update eFa MailWatch && systemctl reload php-fpm httpd
instructions: Option 1 (Interactive CLI Console): Run 'eFa-Configure' via SSH and select '13) Update System & Packages'. Option 2 (Direct Shell Command): dnf clean all && dnf -y update eFa MailWatch && systemctl reload php-fpm httpd
